name: Multilateral Investment Fund
mandate: Support innovation and entrepreneurship in Latin America and the Caribbean.
activities: Serves as the IDB Group’s innovation and venture arm.
plainLanguage: IDB Lab supports early-stage approaches to development challenges and entrepreneurship.

name: Green Climate Fund
mandate: Support low-emission and climate-resilient development in developing countries.
activities: Finances climate mitigation and adaptation and helps countries prepare programmes.
plainLanguage: Countries work with delivery partners to develop climate proposals. The fund can support preparation and implementation.

access.details: See GCF access pathways for accredited entities and project-specific assessment eligibility.

name: Global Environment Facility
mandate: Support action on global environmental challenges.
activities: Channels donor resources through implementing agencies.
plainLanguage: GEF helps countries develop environmental projects through eligible delivery agencies.

access.details: Use a GEF Agency to develop proposals with country counterparts.

name: Adaptation Fund
mandate: Support adaptation in vulnerable developing countries.
activities: Funds practical adaptation activities through implementing entities.
plainLanguage: The Fund pays for practical measures that help communities adapt to climate impacts.

access.details: Eligible parties work with accredited implementing entities.

name: Climate Investment Funds
mandate: Support climate action in low- and middle-income countries.
activities: Works with multilateral development banks to supply concessional climate finance.
plainLanguage: CIF works through development banks to make climate investments viable.

name: Clean Technology Fund
mandate: Support deployment of low-carbon technologies.
activities: Provides concessional resources, including a grant component for the Eastern Caribbean facility.
plainLanguage: The Clean Technology Fund helps development banks finance technologies that reduce emissions.

name: Sustainable Energy Facility for the Eastern Caribbean
mandate: Support renewable energy and energy efficiency investments in the Eastern Caribbean.
activities: Combines development bank and concessional climate resources for eligible energy investments.
plainLanguage: The facility combines financing from multiple institutions for cleaner energy and efficiency in participating countries.

name: Sustainable Energy for the Eastern Caribbean
mandate: Help Eastern Caribbean countries address energy security through efficiency and renewables.
activities: Offers blended resources through a multi-partner initiative.
plainLanguage: SEEC helps participating countries use less energy and shift toward renewable power.

name: CARICOM Development Fund
mandate: Reduce disparities and strengthen economic and social cohesion among participating CARICOM states.
activities: Provides financial and technical assistance through country programmes.
plainLanguage: The Fund supports eligible member states in addressing structural disadvantages within the regional economy.

access.details: Country Assistance Programmes provide the principal channel described by the Fund.

name: Regional Private Sector Development Programme III
mandate: Strengthen CARIFORUM private sector development.
activities: Supports enterprise competitiveness through the EU’s Global Gateway programme.
plainLanguage: The programme is delivered by Caribbean Export to help regional businesses develop and compete.

name: Latin America and Caribbean Investment Facility
mandate: Mobilize sustainable investment in Latin America and the Caribbean.
activities: Uses EU grants with development finance partner resources.
plainLanguage: The facility combines grants and development-bank finance for investments that serve public development priorities.

name: United Kingdom Caribbean Infrastructure Fund
mandate: Build climate-resilient economic infrastructure in eligible Caribbean countries.
activities: Funds infrastructure investments through a CDB-administered grant programme.
plainLanguage: UK assistance pays for eligible infrastructure upgrades through a programme run by CDB.

access.details: Review programme notices for individual procurement opportunities.

name: Special Development Fund
mandate: Address poverty and human development challenges across the Caribbean.
activities: Pools contributor resources and finances activities on concessional terms.
plainLanguage: This is CDB’s dedicated pool for development support on terms designed for eligible borrowers and beneficiaries.

name: Regional Public-Private Partnership Support Facility
mandate: Build Caribbean governments’ capacity to develop public–private partnerships.
activities: Provides policy and project preparation support.
plainLanguage: The facility helps governments plan infrastructure partnerships and assess how to structure them.

name: National Insurance Fund (Barbados)
mandate: Support Barbados social insurance benefits through pooled reserves.
activities: Invests pooled reserves under the social insurance scheme.
plainLanguage: The fund holds and invests reserves that help pay social insurance benefits.

name: Sygnus Credit Investments Limited
mandate: Provide alternative financing to Caribbean middle-market businesses.
activities: Invests through structured private credit instruments.
plainLanguage: The vehicle lends or invests through negotiated credit instruments beyond conventional bank loans.

access.details: Engage the investment manager about eligibility for structured credit.

name: Sygnus Deneb Investments Limited
mandate: Provide growth capital to medium-sized regional businesses.
activities: Makes negotiated equity investments.
plainLanguage: The vehicle takes an ownership stake in businesses to support expansion.

access.details: Engage the vehicle about investment fit and terms.

name: JN Mutual Funds
mandate: Offer investors access to pooled investment portfolios.
activities: Operates portfolios described in the offering document.
plainLanguage: Investors buy into pooled portfolios managed by JN Fund Managers.

name: Global Environment Facility Trust Fund
mandate: Hold and disburse donor contributions for eligible GEF activities.
activities: Administered by the World Bank as trustee and used to finance environmental projects.
plainLanguage: The trust fund holds donor money and releases it for approved GEF activities.

name: Caribbean Community Resilience Fund
mandate: Mobilise long-term capital for Caribbean economic and climate resilience.
activities: Pools capital and invests through separate debt and equity funds across Caribbean markets.
plainLanguage: The umbrella brings funding from multiple investors into one regional platform. Each sleeve supplies a different form of finance.

name: Caribbean Community Resilience Fund Debt Sub-Fund
mandate: Provide loans to regional enterprises and resilience investments.
activities: Extends credit to mid-sized companies and infrastructure investments. IFC announced its participation in 2026.
plainLanguage: This sleeve lends money that borrowers repay.

name: Caribbean Community Resilience Fund Equity Sub-Fund
mandate: Provide equity to Caribbean businesses and resilience investments.
activities: Makes equity investments. IDB Invest disclosed a commitment with blended UK development resources.
plainLanguage: This sleeve takes ownership stakes in eligible investments.

name: Credit Risk Abatement Facility
mandate: Share lender risk on eligible Caribbean renewable energy and efficiency loans.
activities: Provides partial credit guarantees to participating lenders for eligible business energy loans.
plainLanguage: The guarantee covers part of a lender’s risk so businesses can borrow for clean-energy improvements.

name: Caribbean Biodiversity Fund Endowment Fund
mandate: Provide long-term financial resources for Caribbean biodiversity conservation.
activities: Invests pooled assets and uses investment proceeds to support eligible national conservation trust funds.
plainLanguage: The endowment puts its capital to work so it can support conservation over time.

name: Caribbean Biodiversity Fund Ecosystem-based Adaptation Facility
mandate: Finance adaptation using Caribbean ecosystems.
activities: Awards grants to implement ecosystem-based adaptation across eligible Caribbean territories.
plainLanguage: The facility pays for activities such as ecosystem restoration that help communities adapt.

name: Barbados Blue Loan for Marine Conservation
mandate: Refinance sovereign debt to free up resources for marine conservation.
activities: Provided term financing to buy back sovereign debt under the 2022 conversion, using credit guarantees from IDB and TNC.
plainLanguage: Barbados refinanced debt on more favourable terms and committed the savings to marine conservation.

name: Jamaica Catastrophe Bond (2026)
mandate: Back prearranged hurricane cover for Jamaica using capital-market risk transfer.
activities: IBRD issued Capital at Risk Notes CAR 137 to back the separate 2026 risk transfer agreement.
plainLanguage: The bond transfers some hurricane risk to investors. Its design helps finance rapid coverage for qualifying storms.

name: Barbados Energy Smart Fund II
mandate: Expand energy efficiency and renewables and reduce reliance on imported fuels.
activities: Uses a separate pool of capital to finance eligible Barbadian energy investments through EGFL.
plainLanguage: The fund helps businesses pay for renewable power and improvements that use less energy.

name: MPC Caribbean Clean Energy Fund LLC
mandate: Invest in Caribbean renewable infrastructure.
activities: The historical Cayman vehicle invested in Caribbean renewable assets, including Jamaica’s Paradise Park solar development.
plainLanguage: Investors gained exposure to a portfolio of renewable infrastructure through this fund.

name: MPC Caribbean Clean Energy Limited
mandate: Give investors exposure to Caribbean renewable infrastructure.
activities: The listed vehicle channelled capital into the Cayman fund under the original structure. In 2025 it sold the Paradise Park solar asset.
plainLanguage: The listed company gave investors a way to invest in Caribbean renewable infrastructure through exchange-traded shares.

name: Supporting Resilient Green Energy (SuRGE) Programme
mandate: Accelerate Caribbean investments in resilient and low-carbon energy systems.
activities: Uses Canadian grant and loan resources for investment and technical assistance. CDB documents support for geothermal financing in Dominica.
plainLanguage: The programme backs cleaner energy infrastructure and the work needed to prepare those investments.

name: Green Climate Fund Project Preparation Facility
mandate: Support preparation of eligible GCF funding proposals.
activities: Provides proposal preparation funding and services, including approved preparation for CDB’s regional proposal.
plainLanguage: It helps eligible applicants develop the evidence and designs needed to apply for a larger investment.

name: CDB Climate Change Project Preparation Fund
mandate: Help CDB borrowing member countries prepare viable climate investments.
activities: Funds preparation activities such as concept development and technical work for eligible CDB borrowing members.
plainLanguage: The fund helps governments turn climate ideas into proposals that financiers can assess.

name: Global Biodiversity Framework Fund
mandate: Support implementation of the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
activities: Finances biodiversity through a separate GEF trust with the World Bank as trustee and approved activity in Belize.
plainLanguage: It pools resources earmarked for biodiversity and channels them through implementing agencies.

name: Special Climate Change Fund
mandate: Finance adaptation in vulnerable developing countries, including small island developing states.
activities: Supports adaptation and innovation through dedicated funding windows, including a regional Caribbean fisheries operation.
plainLanguage: It helps vulnerable countries finance changes that reduce exposure to climate impacts.

name: BRIDGE Green Transition Grant
mandate: Co-finance environmental improvements by eligible Caribbean exporters.
activities: Provides EU co-financing for environmental improvements through a grant window administered by Caribbean Export.
plainLanguage: Eligible businesses can get a grant to cover part of the cost of greener equipment or operations.

name: Central America and Caribbean Catastrophe Risk Insurance Program Multi-Donor Trust Fund
type: Multi-donor disaster risk finance trust fund
mandate: Earmarked grant funding channel for CCRIF disaster-risk finance.
activities: Canada contributes to the second donor trust fund. EU contributes to the second donor trust fund. US Treasury contributes to the second donor trust fund.
plainLanguage: Earmarked grant funding channel for CCRIF disaster-risk finance.

name: The Bahamas Debt Conversion Project for Marine Conservation (2024)
mandate: Named debt-conversion financing mechanism. Vehicle denotes an arrangement, with no separate legal personality asserted.
activities: IDB supplies first-tier credit enhancement. Builders Vision supplies collateralised co-guarantee support. AXA XL supplies credit insurance.
plainLanguage: Named debt-conversion financing mechanism. Vehicle denotes an arrangement, with no separate legal personality asserted.

name: GEF CReW+ regional water and wastewater financing programme
mandate: Regional programme supporting sustainable water and wastewater financing mechanisms.
activities: GEF supports the regional CReW+ programme. IDB is a co-implementing agency. UNEP is a co-implementing agency.
plainLanguage: Regional programme supporting sustainable water and wastewater financing mechanisms.

name: Caribbean Water, Sanitation and Clean Oceans Programme Loan
mandate: Approved umbrella framework supporting Caribbean water and ocean infrastructure.
activities: EU approved technical-assistance and investment grant support for the umbrella. EIB procures technical assistance for programme delivery.
plainLanguage: Approved umbrella framework supporting Caribbean water and ocean infrastructure.

name: Belize Blue Loan and debt conversion (2021)
mandate: Named sovereign debt-conversion financing arrangement, with no separate legal personality asserted.
activities: DFC provides political risk insurance for principal and interest.
plainLanguage: Named sovereign debt-conversion financing arrangement, with no separate legal personality asserted.
capitalSources: Loan from Belize Blue Investment Company, LLC
